headline: Executive order calls for a national plan aimed at supporting veterans and preventing veteran suicide.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to create a national roadmap focused on empowering veterans and ending suicide among them. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and deadlines involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The order is aimed at creating a national plan to support veterans and reduce suicide among them.
Agencies would likely be involved in developing or carrying out the national roadmap, though the title does not say which ones.
